Quincy.description: you can now use your Dexterity for any Magiscience checks
your scaffolds now provide three-quarters cover
your scaffolds are created with 7 temporary HP

Viktor.description: your Monstrous Minion gains 7 additional temporary HP on initiative roll
your Monstrous Minion's Bite attack deals +4 damage
your Monstrous Minion always has the Fine Stitchwork graft at no cost

Arthur.description: whenever your Attack action's attack is being Helped, it deals +3 damage
whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage to a target adjacent to an ally, the damage is increased by 3
whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage to a target within 10' of another creature, the damage is increased by 2
whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage with an advantaged attack, the damage is increased by 3

Nathaniel.description: goods you purchase in cities you have a positive reputation in cost -1 gold
your expertise die from Townie increases by 2 sizes
enchanted items your party sell in cities you have a positive reputation in sell for +1 gold
